_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file). A PostgreSQL database server for customers who want their own: Debian 12's signed postgresql-15 package and the libraries it needs, downloaded with apt-get download and unpacked into postgresql/ (the Mumble egg's method; glibc comes from the image; LLVM is left out and the server runs with jit=off). The first start runs initdb as the server's own user into data/ (PostgreSQL refuses root) with the postgres user's password (from the Startup tab, or a random one saved in postgres-password.txt) and SCRAM authentication, and allows password logins over the network in pg_hba.conf. data/postgresql.conf is the owner's; listen address, port, socket folder and jit are passed at every start. postgres reads no console input; Ctrl+C is its fast shutdown. The start is its 'ready to accept connections' line or the TCP port once bound.
name: PostgreSQL
author: eggs@octail.net
description: PostgreSQL 15: your own PostgreSQL database server (Debian 12 packages). Connect as the postgres user with the password from the Startup tab, or the generated one in postgres-password.txt.

startup_commands.Default:
P="$(pwd)/postgresql/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin"; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(pwd)/postgresql/usr/lib/$(uname -m)-linux-gnu"; if [ ! -x "${P}/postgres" ]; then echo '[Octail] postgresql/ is missing: reinstall the server.'; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p run; if [ ! -s data/PG_VERSION ]; then echo '[Octail] Creating the database cluster in data/ (first start)'; PW="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"; if [ -z "${PW}" ]; then PW=$(head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' | head -c 32); (umask 077; printf '%s
' "${PW}" > postgres-password.txt); echo '[Octail] Generated a password for the postgres user: it is in postgres-password.txt'; fi; (umask 077; printf '%s
' "${PW}" > run/pwfile); "${P}/initdb" -D data -U postgres --pwfile=run/pwfile --auth=scram-sha-256 --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C.UTF-8; RC=$?; rm -f run/pwfile; [ "${RC}" = 0 ] || { echo '[Octail] Creating the database cluster failed.'; exit 1; }; printf '
# Octail: password logins over the network (the server is only reachable on its port)
host all all 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256
host all all ::/0 scram-sha-256
' >> data/pg_hba.conf; fi; exec "${P}/postgres" -D data -c listen_addresses=0.0.0.0 -c port={{SERVER_PORT}} -c unix_socket_directories="$(pwd)/run" -c jit=off

done: database system is ready to accept connections

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PostgreSQL installation script (Octail's own): Debian 12's signed postgresql-15 package (PostgreSQL 15 with Debian's
# security fixes) and the libraries it needs, downloaded with apt (which checks every package against Debian's signed
# archive) and unpacked into /mnt/server/postgresql, since the server's container can't install packages. The runtime
# image is Debian 12 too, so the libraries match; glibc is never copied (the image's own is used). LLVM (only used by
# the JIT compiler, which this server runs with jit=off) is left out. The database cluster itself is created at the
# first start, as the server's own user (PostgreSQL refuses to run as root). Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

PG_MAJOR=15
cd /mnt/server
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if ! apt-get update -qq; then
    echo "Installation failed: apt couldn't read Debian's package lists."
    exit 1
fi
VERSION=$(apt-cache policy "postgresql-${PG_MAJOR}" | awk '$1 == "Candidate:" { print $2 }')
if [ -z "$VERSION" ] || [ "$VERSION" = "(none)" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: Debian has no postgresql-${PG_MAJOR} package for this architecture."
    exit 1
fi

## the server and every library it needs, following library dependencies only (no postgresql-common, debconf,
## systemd); the C library and its loader always come from the image
PKGS=" "
QUEUE=("postgresql-${PG_MAJOR}")
while [ "${#QUEUE[@]}" -gt 0 ]; do
    PKG="${QUEUE[0]}"
    QUEUE=("${QUEUE[@]:1}")
    case "$PKGS" in *" $PKG "*) continue ;; esac
    PKGS="$PKGS$PKG "
    for DEP in $(apt-cache depends --no-recommends --no-suggests --no-conflicts --no-breaks --no-replaces --no-enhances "$PKG" |
        awk '$1 ~ /^\|?(Pre)?Depends:$/ && $2 !~ /^</ { print $2 }'); do
        DEP="${DEP%%:*}"
        case "$DEP" in
            libc6 | libc-bin | libc-l10n | libc6-* | libpam* | libllvm* | *-data | *-common | *-perl) ;;
            lib* | zlib1g) QUEUE+=("$DEP") ;;
        esac
    done
done

echo "Installing PostgreSQL (postgresql-${PG_MAJOR} ${VERSION}) and its libraries:${PKGS% }"
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
chmod 755 "$TMP"
## apt checks each download against the signed package lists
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
if ! (cd "$TMP" && apt-get download -qq $PKGS); then
    rm -rf "$TMP"
    echo "Installation failed: the packages couldn't be downloaded from Debian."
    exit 1
fi

## the program and its libraries only: the database cluster in data/ stays on a reinstall
rm -rf /mnt/server/postgresql
mkdir -p /mnt/server/postgresql
for DEB in "$TMP"/*.deb; do
    dpkg-deb -x "$DEB" /mnt/server/postgresql
done
rm -rf "$TMP"
rm -rf /mnt/server/postgresql/usr/share/doc /mnt/server/postgresql/usr/share/man \
    "/mnt/server/postgresql/usr/lib/postgresql/${PG_MAJOR}/lib/bitcode" "/mnt/server/postgresql/usr/lib/postgresql/${PG_MAJOR}/lib/llvmjit.so"

for BIN in postgres initdb pg_ctl; do
    if [ ! -x "/mnt/server/postgresql/usr/lib/postgresql/${PG_MAJOR}/bin/$BIN" ]; then
        echo "Installation failed: $BIN is missing after unpacking postgresql-${PG_MAJOR}."
        exit 1
    fi
done
if [ -f data/PG_VERSION ] && [ "$(cat data/PG_VERSION)" != "$PG_MAJOR" ]; then
    echo "Warning: data/ holds a PostgreSQL $(cat data/PG_VERSION) cluster; PostgreSQL ${PG_MAJOR} can't start it."
fi
mkdir -p run

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: PostgreSQL ${VERSION}."
echo "The first start creates the cluster in data/ and the postgres password (Startup tab, or postgres-password.txt)."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Postgres Password
variables.description: Optional: the postgres user's password, set when the database cluster is created at the first start (12-64 letters, digits and _ . @ # % + -). Empty: a random one, saved in postgres-password.txt. Changing it later has no effect: change it with ALTER USER instead. Never shown again once set.
